abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine a useful tumor marker for detecting squamous cell carcinoma arising in a dermoid cyst, and to find the molecular pathogenesis of this condition. METHODS: In 4 cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising in a dermoid cyst and 22 cases of dermoid cyst, we studied tissue expressions and serum levels of squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC), CA 19-9 and CA 125, and the mutation of the p53 tumor suppressor gene. RESULTS: Three of 4 malignant cases had either positive SCC expressions or elevated serum SCC levels. The mean serum SCC level in benign cases was below the cut-off level. CA 19-9 and CA 125 were not detected in squamous cell carcinoma. p53 overexpressions were observed in all malignancies. CONCLUSION: These results suggested that the serum SCC might be a useful marker for detecting squamous cell carcinoma arising in a dermoid cyst, and that the mutation of p53 might be one of the genetic events in the malignant transformation of a dermoid cyst.
abstract_ja:
目的：類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の検出に有用な腫瘍マーカーを見出し、本病態の分子病因を明らかにすること。
方法：類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌4例と類皮嚢腫22例について、組織中発現および血清中濃度の扁平上皮癌抗原(SCC)、CA 19-9、CA 125、およびp53腫瘍抑制遺伝子の変異を検討した。
結果：悪性4例中3例で、SCCの組織内発現陽性または血清SCC値の上昇がみられた。良性例の血清SCC平均値はカットオフ値未満であった。扁平上皮癌ではCA 19-9およびCA 125は検出されなかった。全ての悪性例でp53の過剰発現がみられた。
結論：血清SCCは類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の検出に有用な腫瘍マーカーとなる可能性があり、p53の変異は類皮嚢腫の悪性転化における遺伝学的事象の一つと考えられる。
